university.name: University of Liverpool
university.summary: Research university in Liverpool offering undergraduate, taught master's and research degrees across law, computing, engineering, business, economics, science and humanities. International applicants select their country on the course pages; the University of Liverpool International College runs foundation and pre-master's routes.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor (gov.uk register dated 2026-10-07): University of Liverpool, Liverpool, Higher Education Institution (HEI), Student Sponsor, Track Record, Student route.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.overview: Three-year degree whose first year covers programming, programming language paradigms, designing digital systems and data structures and algorithms. UCAS code G400.
highlights: Designing Systems for the Digital Society
courses.academic_requirements: A levels AAB including Mathematics or Computer Science (ABB with an A in the Extended Project Qualification); IB 34 points overall or 6,6,5 in three HL subjects including Mathematics or Computer Science. GCSE English and Mathematics at grade 4/C.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall, with no component below 5.5.
courses.career_notes: The course page lists programmer, software developer and systems analyst roles, with employers including BAE Systems, BT, Siemens and Unilever.
courses.application_deadline_note: Starts 27 September 2027. UCAS deadline for UK applicants 13 January 2027; international deadline 30 June 2027.
courses.notes: No Pakistan-specific entry requirements were found: the course page shows only UK qualifications and a country selector. The page says a Foundation Certificate, such as the one at the University of Liverpool International College, can guarantee a place on similar courses, but there is no direct foundation route listed for this course.

courses.title: Law
courses.overview: Three-year law degree whose first year covers foundations of law and social justice, contract, public law and criminal law. UCAS code M100.
highlights: Foundations of Law and Social Justice
courses.academic_requirements: A levels AAA (AAB with an A in the Extended Project Qualification); IB 36 points overall with no score below 4, or the IB Diploma plus 6,6,6 in three HL subjects. GCSE English and Mathematics at grade 4/C.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, with no component below 5.5.
courses.career_notes: The course page says most graduates enter the legal profession.
courses.notes: No Pakistan-specific entry requirements were found. The page mentions no admissions test.

courses.title: Mechanical Engineering
courses.overview: Three-year engineering degree whose first year covers professional engineering skills, engineering materials, energy science and solids and structures. UCAS code H300.
courses.academic_requirements: A levels AAB including Mathematics and a second science (ABB with an A in the Extended Project Qualification). GCSE English and Mathematics at grade 4/C.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall, with no component below 5.5.
courses.career_notes: The course page says mechanical engineering graduates are sought after in engineering fields and a range of other sectors.
courses.notes: No Pakistan-specific entry requirements were found. An MEng version of the course exists with its own page, not researched here.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.overview: Twelve-month conversion master's for graduates of science or engineering subjects other than computer science, with first-semester modules in research methods, programming, databases and algorithms.
courses.academic_requirements: 2:2 honours degree from a UK university or an equivalent non-UK qualification, in a science or engineering related subject such as Mathematics or Physical Sciences; the degree should not be in Computer Science.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, with no component below 5.5; PTE Academic 61 overall with no component below 59; TOEFL iBT 88 overall for tests taken on or before 20 January 2026, and 4.5 overall with 4 or above in each component for tests from 21 January 2026 (Home Edition not accepted).
courses.career_notes: The course page lists database administrator, applications developer, IT consultant and systems designer roles, and notes the course is a foundation for PhD research.
courses.notes: No Pakistan-specific entry requirements were found. min_toefl is null because the TOEFL scale changed in January 2026 and the page gives two sets of scores. Module list on the page reflects the 2026 intake and is due to be updated by 30 April 2027. The fee is shown per year for a 12-month course.

courses.title: Finance
courses.overview: Twelve-month master's in finance with modules such as corporate finance and valuation, portfolio analysis, financial econometrics and security analysis. Applicants need a degree in finance, accounting or economics.
courses.academic_requirements: 2:2 honours degree from a UK university or an equivalent non-UK qualification, in Finance, Accounting or Economics; exceptional candidates in other subjects with a significant finance component may be considered.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, with no component below 6.0; PTE Academic 61 overall with no component below 59; TOEFL iBT 88 overall for tests taken on or before 20 January 2026, and 4.5 overall with 4 or above in each component for tests from 21 January 2026.
courses.career_notes: The course page lists roles in retail and investment banks, securities firms, portfolio management and central banks, and mentions a Career Accelerator project.
courses.notes: No Pakistan-specific entry requirements were found. min_toefl is null because the scale changed in January 2026. Module list reflects the 2026 intake and is due to be updated by 30 April 2027.

courses.title: Economics
courses.overview: Twelve-month master's with compulsory microeconomics, macroeconomics and applied econometrics, plus options such as policy evaluation and causal inference. Applicants should have competency in A level Mathematics or Statistics or equivalent.
courses.academic_requirements: 2:2 honours degree from a UK university or an equivalent non-UK qualification, in Economics or a closely related quantitative discipline; a 2:2 in a quantitative science is also encouraged. Competency in A level Mathematics or Statistics or equivalent expected.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, with no component below 6.0; PTE Academic 61 overall with no component below 59; TOEFL iBT 88 overall for tests taken on or before 20 January 2026, and 4.5 overall with 4 or above in each component for tests from 21 January 2026.
courses.career_notes: The course page points to research-oriented careers in finance, international organisations, central banks and academia, and names the Bank of England among employers.
courses.notes: The page states the GBP 31,000 fee is for 2026/27 and will be updated: target year fee not yet published. The other Liverpool master's pages checked show 2027/28 fees. No Pakistan-specific entry requirements were found.

courses.title: Master in Management
courses.overview: Twelve-month general management master's with modules such as operations decision making and business analytics, digital marketing, strategic management and organisational behaviour.
highlights: Operations Decision Making and Business Analytics
Marketing Management in the Digital Age
courses.academic_requirements: 2:2 honours degree from a UK university or an equivalent non-UK qualification.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, with no component below 6.0; PTE Academic 61 overall with no component below 59; TOEFL iBT 88 overall for tests taken on or before 20 January 2026, and 4.5 overall with 4 or above in each component for tests from 21 January 2026.
courses.career_notes: The course page names employers such as KPMG, Deloitte, EY and Amazon and roles including assurance associate, project manager and commercial analyst.
courses.application_deadline_note: Starts 27 September 2027; international deadline 23 August 2027. A January 2027 start is also listed on the page.
courses.notes: No Pakistan-specific entry requirements were found. min_toefl is null because the scale changed in January 2026. Module list is illustrative and due to be updated by 30 April 2027.

scholarships.name: Liverpool Excellence Scholarship for Postgraduates
scholarships.summary: Tuition discount for new international students joining a taught master's at the Liverpool campus with a first class degree or equivalent. Awarded automatically once the offer is accepted and the deposit paid.
scholarships.criteria_text: First Class or equivalent undergraduate degree; self-funded at the international rate; full- or part-time taught master's including MRes; accept offer and pay deposit by the advertised deadlines. Not for sponsored students, PGCert, professional doctorates, MPhil, MArch or PhD, or International College pre-master's completers.
scholarships.deadline_note: No application; the offer acceptance and deposit deadlines advertised in the offer apply.
scholarships.notes: The page gives terms for the 2026/27 academic year only. It does not give a Pakistan equivalent of a first class degree and refers applicants to a country equivalence check (the equivalence page could not be read). Cannot be held with the Advancement, Achievement or Attainment (India) or Graduate Loyalty International scholarships.

scholarships.name: Liverpool Excellence Scholarship for Undergraduates
scholarships.summary: First-year tuition discount for new international undergraduates who achieve AAA at A level or an equivalent. Awarded automatically to all eligible students.
scholarships.criteria_text: Pays full international fees; has not studied at Liverpool before; new undergraduate degree on the Liverpool campus, excluding MBChB and BDS; AAA at A level or equivalent (First Class or equivalent for two-year MArch); not online; not sponsor-funded; cannot be combined with other scholarships.
scholarships.notes: The URL carries 'global-advancement' in its path but the page content describes the GBP 7,500 award for AAA, which the scholarships finder lists as the Liverpool Excellence Scholarship for Undergraduates. A separate Undergraduate Global Advancement Scholarship of up to GBP 5,000 is mentioned on another page without terms. The page does not state whether an offer is required; requires_offer is set true as eligibility depends on achieving the grades after an offer.

scholarships.name: Postgraduate Global Advancement Scholarship (Country)
scholarships.value_text: Tuition fee discount: GBP 2,500 on the country page; GBP 5,000 on the scholarships finder summary
scholarships.summary: Tuition discount for new international master's students from listed countries including Pakistan, studying on campus and paying their own fees. Awarded without a separate application once the offer is accepted and the deposit paid.
scholarships.criteria_text: Eligible master's course including MRes, on campus in Liverpool; self-funded at the international rate; no previous master's degree; not a Liverpool or XJTLU graduate or International College student; not sponsored; accept offer and pay deposit by the offer deadline. Combined awards capped at 50 per cent of tuition.
scholarships.deadline_note: No application; the deposit deadline in the offer letter applies.
scholarships.notes: The page names Pakistan in its Asia list (with Bangladesh, Brunei Darussalam, India, Japan, Malaysia and the Maldives) but is internally inconsistent on dates: it says January 2026 starts only, yet criteria say from September 2025, and it says September 2026 awards will be announced later. The value is GBP 2,500 on this page but the scholarships finder lists an Advancement Scholarship for Pakistan and other countries at GBP 5,000 for 2026/27. value_amount is left null until confirmed.
